highlights.title: Fix crash when deleting therapy schedule entries
changes: Deleting a time segment in ISF, glucose target, carb ratio, or basal editors no longer crashes the app.
Deleting an entry via swipe, context menu, or VoiceOver now reliably removes it without error.
The time/value picker remains stable if an entry is removed while it is open and will not cause a crash.
The same fix is applied to the four onboarding therapy-setting steps so they behave the same way.

changes: X-axis time labels on the main chart and all stats charts are correctly aligned again.
The Glucose Distribution (by day) chart's missing x-axis labels are restored and visible.
Percentile and distribution-by-time chart labels are now centered on their marks for clearer alignment.
Removed redundant labels and added glucose units above the Percentile (by day) chart's y-axis.

changes: Omnipod Bluetooth was improved, adding a better keep‑alive, an O5 beep fix, and more reliable connections.
DanaKit fixes corrected dose end dates and improved concurrency safety.
LibreLoop now clears standing CGM alerts correctly when a sensor is deleted.
Loop algorithm tweaks smooth insulin-on-board behavior and limit correction rates.
App translations were updated in several components.

includedPullRequests.title: Fix index-out-of-range crash when deleting a schedule entry
includedPullRequests.body:
## Summary

Deleting a time segment in the ISF, glucose target, carb ratio or basal editor could kill the app with `Fatal error: Index out of range`. 

The fix takes index bindings out of the therapy settings item row entirely:

  - `ForEach(items)` iterates values, so `item.id` in an action is a captured `UUID` rather than a binding read
  - `deleteItem(with:)` resolves the index by id at call time — used by the swipe action, the context menu and the VoiceOver delete action (which previously also read `item.id` through the binding)
  - the picker row gets an id-keyed binding whose setter no-ops if the entry is gone
  - `validateTherapySettingItems()` keeps ids stable; selection falls back to time-matching only when the selected entry
  actually disappeared

This fix touches the shared editor for all therapy settings, so it covers ISF, glucose target, carb ratio and basal editors as well as the four onboarding therapy-setting steps.

Fixes #1497

includedPullRequests.title: Fix x-axis label alignment in stats and main charts for SDK 27
includedPullRequests.body:
Fixes #1525 

## Summary

Building Trio with Xcode 27 to iOS 27 shifts x-axis labels out of alignment across the
statistics charts and the main chart, and hides them entirely on the glucose
Distribution (by day) chart.

Three Swift Charts behaviours changed in the iOS 27 SDK. Each is gated on the
**linked SDK**, not the OS: the same source built with Xcode 26 renders
correctly on an iOS 27 device, so this only started affecting users once Trio
was built with Xcode 27.

| Swift Charts API | Behaviour under SDK 27 |
|---|---|
| `AxisValueLabel(centered: true)` | Centres across the span to the next *labelled* mark instead of one stride unit |
| `AxisValueLabel(anchor:)` | Silently ignored unless `preset: .aligned` is also set |
| `.chartYAxisLabel` | Consumes the x-axis label row when combined with `.chartScrollableAxes` |

## Changes

**SDK 27 fixes**

- **Stats charts** — every chart strides finely and labels sparsely (stride by
  day, label weekly), so the `centered:` change pushed labels right by half the
  *label* spacing: ~3.5 days in month view, ~half a month in 3M, 3 hours in day
  view. Five near-duplicate axis blocks are replaced with one
  `StatChartUtils.dateAxisMarks(for:)` that emits an `AxisValueLabel` on every
  stride value — empty where no label is wanted — so "next labelled mark" once
  again equals "next stride value". That is correct under both the old and the
  new semantics, and a no-op on iOS 26. The mark closing the domain is left
  unlabelled so `preset: .aligned` stops pinning its centred label on top of the
  preceding one (the `TueWe` overlap in week view, the stray clipped `0` in day
  view).
- **Main chart** — already passed `anchor: .top`; adding `preset: .aligned`
  makes it take effect again. Verified the glucose, basal and COB/IOB panes stay
  column-aligned: gridline positions are identical across all three panes with
  and without the preset.
- **Distribution (by day)** — this is the one chart that is both scrollable and
  used `.chartYAxisLabel`, so it is the only one whose x-axis labels disappeared.
  Removing the label fixes it; a y-axis label cannot be reinstated on that chart
  while it is scrollable.

**Deliberate changes (not regressions)**

- **Centre on-mark labels** — Percentile/Distribution by time and Looping
  Performance had left-aligned labels sitting ~5pt right of their mark on *every*
  SDK. They are now centred via `preset: .aligned` + `anchor: .top`.
- **Label cleanup** — dropped the redundant "Percentage" labels and the
  "Glucose Distribution" heading, and added the glucose units above the y-axis of
  Percentile (by day), which had none.

Bar charts keep `centered: true` throughout: their labels measure 0px from bar
centre, which is the right target for a bar. Only point/area charts centre on the
mark.

## Testing

Each configuration was measured against rule marks placed at the exact target
position, on the iOS 26.5 and iOS 27.0 simulators, built against both SDK 26.5
and SDK 27.0:

| | SDK 26.5 build | SDK 27 build, before | SDK 27 build, after |
|---|---|---|---|
| `centered:` span | 0px | +115px | 0px |
| `anchor: .top` | 0px | +32px | 0px |
| main chart | 0px | +32 to +36px | 0 to −1px |

The old and new label-selection logic were also compared exhaustively — 90 days
of axis marks × all four intervals × both original code paths — with zero
unintended differences; the only changes are the intended trailing-mark trims.

includedPullRequests.title: Update submodules to current upstream 18-09-2026
includedPullRequests.body:
## Summary

Refreshes the seven submodules that have moved since the last update.
Headline is OmnipodKit's PKA "When Open" base Pod Keep Alive level for
all BLE pods. The other nine are already at their branch tips.

- OmnipodKit: "When Open" base PKA level for all BLE pods, silent-beep
  O5 pod fix, eager connect watchdog for InPlay/iPhone-16 wedges
- DanaKit: mutable-dose endDate fix, concurrency-safety tweaks
- LibreLoop: retract standing alerts on CGM delete
- LoopKit: translations, LoopKit:dev merged into trio
- LoopAlgorithm: IOB ripple fix, IntegralRC correction-rate ceiling
- G7SensorKit: translations
- LibreTransmitter: translations

| Submodule | Branch | Old → New | Commits |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OmnipodKit | `main` | `3b20e3b` → `4e923d7` | 7 |
| DanaKit | `dev` | `f41d225` → `a2d3aa4` | 7 |
| LibreLoop | `trio` | `d1912f6` → `d98a9ee` | 2 |
| LoopKit | `trio` | `1c1667a` → `d52c298` | 2 |
| LoopAlgorithm | `main` | `2f5c630` → `7d016fb` | 3 |
| G7SensorKit | `main` | `1486241` → `c2abb4f` | 1 |
| LibreTransmitter | `main` | `61e9981` → `125745b` | 1 |

Unchanged and already at tip: `AccuChekKit`, `CGMBLEKit`, `EversenseKit`, `LibreCRKit`, `MedtrumKit`, `MinimedKit`, `RileyLinkKit`, `TidepoolService`, `dexcom-share-client-swift`.
